## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.1

This cleanup release improves the embedded Terminal workflow, aligns the footer buttons and workbook path display, and centers Version Information in the banner. The Terminal tab and the Open Terminal button both start the command interface.

Builds use the versioned filename USB-Drive-Inventory-Collector-v4.2.1.exe. The README includes a feature list, a Table of Contents, and tables for interface controls and terminal keys.
